evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: music search/discovery; listed methods are attributes, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Single feature (search/discover personalized by profile); not combining independent features.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Single feature (recommendation/search using similar users); not multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: content-similarity based search; variants are attributes, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Single feature (metadata-driven search); enumerated data sources are attributes of the same feature.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Single coherent feature: uploading videos with persistent tags; persistence is part of the upload feature.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing thumbnail sequences.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: retrieving info about similar items/segments (attributes describe scope).

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: information retrieval about perceptually similar content.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: recommendation based on similar profiles.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: recommendation based on local news relevance.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Combines detection (identify persons) and enrichment/action (retrieve related information) which are independently implementable features.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Combines product identification and retrieval of related information—two separable features.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Logo detection and fetching related info are distinct, independently implementable capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification and information lookup are separable features; story bundles both.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: image-based recommendation; alternate input methods are attributes, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area, monuments or any other relevant point of interest
evaluations.rationale: Single map-based discovery/notification feature; listed examples are scope attributes, not independent features.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: ASR-based search capability.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Combines viewing, validating and editing segmentation — these are separate, independently implementable operations on segmentation.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Combines manual annotation and automated topic extraction; annotation and extraction are separable features.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Filtering and ranking are distinct operations that can be implemented and prioritized separately.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: quick assessment of possible editing (integrity check).

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: nudity prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: low-level search-based prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: automated copyright validation of ingested content.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: high-level metadata/tag based prefiltering; examples are attributes.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Single assessment feature using multiple input sources; the inputs are attributes, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: prompt-detection for scientists; data sources are attributes.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: volunteer type identification.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: preclassification using low-level features.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Single detection feature: identifying empty/no-classifiable-animal images.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: image series detection for timestamp issues.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: attribute preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: counting animals in images.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Segmentation/localization are alternative outputs of one vision feature rather than independent features; treated as one capability.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Single detection feature: identify images without classifiable plankton.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Size and orientation are attributes of plankton detection/measurement; described as one measurement feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: motion analysis to shorten videos.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Single detection feature: detect egg-laying timepoints.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Single detection feature covering several target feature types; enumeration lists scope, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: weighting/assessing classifications by experience.

evaluations.evidence: prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Single prefiltering feature; examples are types of artefacts (attributes).

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Single detection feature covering moving/transient objects; combined terms describe scope, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Single audio-cleaning feature; listed noise types are aspects of the same capability.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: clustering/grouping similar calls.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: counting whales in audio.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single decision-support feature: detecting appropriate interruption times.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: deciding interruption medium; enumerated mediums are attributes of the decision.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detect when to present education.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Single decision feature about education medium; options are attributes, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: selecting educational content for a volunteer.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detecting interesting comments.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: trigger detection for bot comments.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: triggering explanatory responses by Zoonibot.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: determining bot message content.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: grouping subjects by similarity.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Single recommendation feature using volunteer history.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: providing article summaries for reuse.
